body:
Publishing to the VS Code Marketplace needs an Azure DevOps PAT (scope: All accessible organizations -> Marketplace: Manage). Open VSX + `vsce package` do not need it; only `vsce publish` to the Marketplace does.
GOTCHA (2026-08-09): Microsoft now REQUIRES linking an active Azure subscription to CREATE a new Azure DevOps org (signup: "you need to link it to an Azure subscription... Owner or Contributor role"). Both a work account (aman@khanakia.com, stale Entra sub) and a personal account (khanakia@live.com, no sub) hit this wall. dev.azure.com is the right (free) product; portal.azure.com / azure.microsoft.com pricing pages are Azure CLOUD (wrong; wants a card). User resolved by upgrading to Pay-As-You-Go, then created the org + PAT.
Budget reality: Azure has NO native hard spend cap. Budgets (Cost Management -> Budgets) are ALERT-ONLY (email at thresholds, do not stop billing). The old "Spending limit" that halts services exists only on free/credit subs, not PAYG. A true auto-stop needs budget + Action Group + automation runbook (overkill). BUT the DevOps org + PAT + vsce publish workflow provisions ZERO billable resources — cost is $0 as long as no paid resource (VM/DB/pipeline beyond free) is created; a $10 budget with 50/80/100% email alerts is just a tripwire.
Current state: VSCE_PAT (84 chars) is in apps/vscode/.env (gitignored) and VERIFIED (`vsce verify-pat khanakia` succeeded), so `cd apps/vscode && task publish` now auto-publishes to the Marketplace. PAT expires (max 1yr) -> regenerate + update that line.
